# Grand Hyatt Dubai Spa

> The spa and health club at Grand Hyatt Dubai serves guests and members of the resort in Umm Hurair, between Dubai Creek and Dubai Healthcare City. It holds treatment rooms, hydrotherapy and steam suites, a gymnasium and swimming pools set within the hotel's landscaped grounds. The host hotel opened in March 2003 with 710 rooms and suites and more than a dozen restaurants and bars.' Apply the same text to row 66 if both records survive.

## Project Overview

- Category: Hospitality & Landmark Entertainment
- Location: Umm Hurair 2, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

Grand Hyatt Dubai is a five-star hotel on Sheikh Rashid Road in central Dubai, and this project covered the development of the hotel's spa facilities. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the spa development for Grand Hyatt, with WSP as consultant. The project reflects MENASCO's experience in delivering building services within operating luxury hotels.
